research_role: Launch provenance, creator/funder/entity adjustment, copycat/manufacturing evidence and historical metadata preservation. Not a general wallet-profitability ledger.

licensing_boundary.frozen_pre_2026_09_13_public_deposit: Use only according to the frozen release's observed CC0-1.0 terms and provenance.
licensing_boundary.current_live_database_and_api: Treat as separately licensed/current terms. Do not infer CC0 inheritance, redistribute licensed bulk data, or work around quotas.
licensing_boundary.rule: License is release-specific and time-specific. Store source version and observed terms with every bulk research import.

field_semantics.creator: Launch creator identity as recorded by the source; useful provenance, not alone proof of common control.
field_semantics.created_at: Launch-time anchor subject to source capture/rebuild provenance.
field_semantics.late_discovery: Must stratify live-observed vs late/rebuilt records. Do not train time-sensitive launch features as if late records were observed live.
field_semantics.dev_pct: Creator initial supply-share style field. Context/risk feature, not monotonic alpha.
field_semantics.dev_sold: Observed creator selling state under source semantics. Absence is not proof of future alignment.
field_semantics.unique_buyers: Whole-life buyer count may include post-graduation market buyers. It is NOT a curve-only early independent-buyer count.
field_semantics.curve_buyers: Outside-creator bonding-curve buyers under source semantics. UNKNOWN/missing cannot become zero.
field_semantics.snap30_buyers: First-30-second buyer snapshot may contain market buyers if a launch graduates quickly. It is not interchangeable with curve_buyers.
field_semantics.bundled_buyers: Creation-block/bundled buyer evidence. Useful entity/manipulation control, not standalone intent proof.
field_semantics.graduated: Potentially inferred/over-broad lifecycle field. Never use alone as authoritative completion.
field_semantics.graduated_confirmed_by: Preferred authoritative graduation evidence when populated, e.g. pool or curve_complete. Preserve exact confirmation source.
field_semantics.create_slot: On-chain ordering context; preserve distinction between slot/block ordering and decode timestamps.
field_semantics.metadata_hash_and_image_hash: Useful for copycat/reuse/provenance comparison. Hash equality proves byte/content equality only, not common intent.
field_semantics.curve_state_read_timestamp: Mutable observation timestamp. Staleness must travel with the value.
field_semantics.peak_price: Observed peak floor under source coverage, not guaranteed global MFE and not realizable exit.
field_semantics.peak_at: Observation timestamp for peak evidence, source-qualified.
field_semantics.peak_source: Must be retained. External peak evidence is weaker than event-backed curve/AMM evidence for execution research.
field_semantics.quote_mint: Quote-asset field must be preserved. Never generalize one archive-era quote assumption to all current Pump custom-pair events.
field_semantics.curve_rows_dropped: Signals possible historical row retention/incompleteness. Incomplete history must not be interpreted as zero activity.
field_semantics.wallet_flow: Current licensed schema is specialized toward wallets associated with curve buyouts/operator analysis, not a census of all early buyers and not a generic smart-wallet ledger.
field_semantics.trades: Source-specific retained trade subset; do not assume complete token trade tape without checking release semantics.
field_semantics.hist_trades: Reconstructed historical trades may provide actual block time, but reconstructed provenance must remain distinct from live-observed records.

source_clean_record_rules_not_alpha_thre.framework_rule: Never import these cutoffs as positive Alpha Lab thresholds without independent winner/failure replication and prospective validation.

entity_and_funder_rules: Shared funder is evidence of relationship, not proof of same controller; trading terminals and shared infrastructure can create false links.
Combine funder evidence with co-entry, transfer paths, bundle behavior, repeated creator/operator relationships and timing before common-control attribution.
If the current source withholds or re-derives operator/funder graph tables, preserve UNKNOWN and the source version rather than silently substituting stale relationships.
Wallet skill and entity identity are separate concepts: a common operator can be skilled, manipulative, both or neither.
metadata_and_lore_rules: Launch metadata is perishable; archived hash/content evidence can be more informative than current URLs.
Rebuilt records cannot recover original off-chain content if it changed or disappeared unless that content was preserved at launch.
Image/document reuse can identify copycat/factory patterns but cannot by itself prove fraudulent intent.
First-of-chain or original-lore claims require independent provenance, not token metadata alone.
outcome_rules: Graduation is lifecycle state, not profit.
Observed peak is not sellable return.
A clean provenance record is not a BUY signal.
The source's September cohort finding that no measured bonding-curve positions reached 5x is a dated regime/source-specific falsifier, not a universal Pump.fun tail prior.
Any Chain of Title field entering G3 must be observable before the candidate cutoff or explicitly treated as later adjudication/context.

approved: creator-history controls AS-OF when timestamps allow
not_approved: current licensed API as an unrestricted bulk source
